description: Chemicals supplies chemical-property data and calculation routines, including correlations and phase-equilibrium support for process models. The cited provider is Caleb Bell. The model domain and scenario period depend on the user-defined system and inputs; geographic validation and numerical resolution are not established here. Access starts from the cited provider page or document; no underlying files were retrieved. It is released under the MIT licence and installs free with pip from PyPI. Documentation does not establish completeness, calibration quality or suitability for a particular simulation. For infrastructure simulation, it can support process, production or industrial-exposure scenario development. Related by subject to model-dwsim-process-simulator; this comparison does not assert tested interoperability.
